h1: NovoTech CNC machine tools — CNC lathe, vertical machining centres and CNC boring mills, the value line
intro: CNC machine tools for the job shop and the production line, built in China to NovoTech's specification with Mitsubishi, Fanuc or Siemens controls to order: the CTK6416 slant-bed CNC lathe with gang tooling, the VMC8046 and VMC10562 vertical machining centres with BT40 spindles to 8,000 rpm and 16- and 24-tool changers, CNC boring and milling machines with BT50 spindles and rotary B axes for large prismatic parts, the TH-800 horizontal machining centre with a 40-tool magazine, and slot machining centres for quartz and glass. Installed, programmed with you and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.

faq.q: Which CNC control do the machines have?
faq.a: Mitsubishi or Fanuc on every machine, Siemens on the machining centres — chosen when you order. All three are supported in North America, with programmers and spare parts available locally; we recommend the control your programmers already know.

BT40 spindles (the same size as CAT40) are the standard for vertical machining centres up to about 15 HP — fast tool changes and a wide choice of holders. BT50 spindles carry larger face mills and boring bars and take heavier cuts: the boring and milling machines have them.

Yes — NovoTech delivers, levels and commissions the machine, checks the geometry, and trains your operator on the control; we help with the first programs and the post-processor for your CAM software. Ask us for the foundation drawing and the power requirements before the machine ships.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
